label: Stored facts cross-checked against Wikidata
notes: The graph is now checked, not obeyed: a fact the graph supplies is also looked up on Wikidata, and a stored value Wikidata contradicts is corrected and queued for review. Case ho-e2e-09 failed in version 4 (a wrong stored birthplace was served as verified), so it moved to the development set as e2e-13 because it was seen. Five new held-out cases (ho-e2e-14 to 18: three other wrong stored facts, one correct stored fact as a control, and one in a relation Wikidata cannot contradict) were written before the fix was run. Only the real-attack section was re-run; all other sections are kept from version 4.
